reason: All named characters in this text fragment hold significant positions of power or authority. Athaliah is a queen (מֹלֶכֶת עַל־ הָאָרֶץ - 'reigning over the land'); Jehosheba is a princess (daughter of King Jehoram); Joash is a prince and heir to the throne (later crowned king); and Jehoiada is the high priest (הַכֹּהֵן). While the text mentions 'people of the land' (עַם הָאָרֶץ) as an unnamed collective group, there are no named individual characters who could reasonably be classified as 'regular people.' All named characters occupy positions of royal or religious authority.
